edits: Replaced the filled bone-and-outline mark with a single-colour dark C drawn directly on the gold face: an 8x9 glyph with a two-pixel spine, rounded bars, an empty gold counter, and a three-pixel-tall centred opening at right. Rendered the hand-authored 16x16 RGBA grid, then upscaled 4x to 64x64 with integer nearest-neighbour sampling and encoded an 8-bit RGBA PNG using Python's struct and zlib standard-library modules. Derived captain-off.png pixel-by-pixel from captain.png: preserved transparent pixels and the #1b1512 outline exactly; converted every other opaque pixel to Rec.601 luminance (0.299R + 0.587G + 0.114B), multiplied by 0.60, rounded to the nearest integer, and wrote that value to R, G, and B while preserving alpha. Created captain-sheet.png using nearest-neighbour previews at 64, 32, and 26 px on #0e1115 and #ece8de backgrounds.
